answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in wharf, verified in signal, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the sparrow check. A farm of 3976 identities would post 1310 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
